About this site

Helps users reach official information from public institutions and related organizations quickly.

  • This guide helps you find the responsible public institution or related organization by topic and continue to that organization's own official announcement.
  • It is not an official government website.
  • It is not a breaking-news service, news site, or fact-checking service.
  • It does not rate organizations or sources, or provide AI summaries or decisions.

Free to use. There are no ads or affiliate links, and no sign-in is required.

This is not an official government website, breaking-news service, or fact-checking service. Listing does not guarantee the overall reliability of an organization or the accuracy of information at a destination.

Before using this site
  • Listing does not recommend an organization as a whole or guarantee its reliability.
  • This site does not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or currency of destination information. Check the organization's own official announcements directly for current information.
  • For evacuation and safety decisions during a disaster, follow the latest information from the relevant authorities.
  • Display order does not represent importance, reliability, accuracy, or recommendation. Destination groups and usage situations do not represent importance or urgency.
  • The destination site's policies apply after you leave this site.

Destinations are external official websites. Check the linked site for the latest information.
